title: Certified Algorithms for Gaussian Location Mixture NPMLEs via Discretized Gradient Flows
abstract: arXiv:2611.19882v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the computation of approximate nonparametric maximum likelihood estimators (NPMLEs) for Gaussian location mixtures in arbitrary dimension $d\ge 1$ via the Fisher-Rao gradient flow. We provide a certified algorithm based on an entropic proximal discretization of the flow which, given a sufficiently small $\varepsilon > 0$, returns an absolutely continuous mixing measure $\tilde\mu$ admitting an exact finite-dimensional representation and satisfying $\hat L_n-L_n(f_{\tilde\mu})\le\varepsilon$. For almost every dataset $X_1,\cdots, X_n \in \mathbb{R}^d$ satisfying $n>2(d+1)(m+1)^2$, where $m$ is the number of support points of the NPMLE, the algorithm requires $O(n\varepsilon^{-1}\log^{d+2}(1/\varepsilon))$ time. En route, we also establish results on the well-posedness and convergence properties of the continuous-time Fisher--Rao flow. tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于Fisher-Rao梯度流熵邻近离散化的认证算法，能够在与样本量近线性、与 $1/\varepsilon$ 多项式相关的时间内计算高斯位置混合NPMLE的 $\varepsilon$-近似解，且所得估计具有精确有限维表示并附带似然差距保证。
